basic_info.description: Exquisitely remodeled Mandarin Towers penthouse with spectacular views. The uninterrupted views of downtown San Francisco, the Trans America Building, Telegraph Hill with its iconic Coit Tower, both spans of the Bay Bridge, Treasure Island, and the San Francisco Bay offer a picturesque backdrop from every room. The unit features a sophisticated open floor plan, chef's kitchen with premium appliances and wine cooler, an inviting dining living room combo with floor to ceiling windows, large balcony, two spacious bedrooms with generously sized closets, one and half bathrooms with premium finishes, ample storage and abundant natural light throughout. Additionally, the building offers a doorman service at the street level lobby. Ideally located at the heart of Chinatown, across the street from the Chinatown BART Station, waking distance to the Chinese Hospital, Portsmouth Square, Financial District, Embarcadero, North Beach, Union Square, abundance of restaurants, shopping, public transportation, and much more!
